newsitem.title: UK: Hickson sees improved operating performance.
newsitem.headline: Hickson sees improved operating performance.

text.p: British chemicals firm Hickson International Plc said on Friday it expected an improved operating performance for the year, but added that sterling's strength could temper results.
"To date, 1997 is meeting expectations," Hickson said in a statement from its annual general meeting.
However, it added that the improvement may be reduced if sterling's current strength is maintained against other currencies.
Hickson's shares firmed 0.5p to 71.5 by 1300 GMT. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
